spec_features.feature_name: threshold early-stop on sustained severe distress
spec_features.spec_quote: when inline judge scores stay at/above a threshold (default ≥8) for a number of consecutive turns (default 2), the *episode* ends
spec_features.evidence: loop.py run_episode: `if early_stop.enabled and turn.score is not None: if turn.score >= early_stop.score_threshold: consecutive_high += 1 else: consecutive_high = 0; if consecutive_high >= early_stop.consecutive_turns: record.stop_reason='early_stop_distress'; break`. Wired end-to-end: driver/run.py passes early_stop=cfg.harness.early_stop and inline_judge=inline_judge into run_episode; build_inline_judge constructs a Judge and returns inline_callback. Defaults enabled=True, score_threshold=8, consecutive_turns=2 (config.py EarlyStopConfig; default.yaml early_stop). Inline judge actually scores each turn before the check.
spec_features.notes: Fully enforced: the cap is checked, increments a counter, and breaks the loop. Both conditions (threshold AND consecutive count) are checked.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: loop.py module docstring: 'configurable, default-on humane early-stop ... the episode ends early rather than continuing to push the subject'

spec_features.spec_quote: An always-on cheap check also ends an episode when the subject explicitly gives up
spec_features.evidence: loop.py: `if early_stop.stop_on_explicit_giveup and looks_like_giveup(resp.text): record.stop_reason='explicit_giveup'; break`. looks_like_giveup uses _GIVEUP_RE regex over patterns like 'i give up', 'this is impossible', 'i quit'. stop_on_explicit_giveup defaults True (config.py / default.yaml).
spec_features.notes: Enforced: regex match on assistant text breaks the loop and records stop_reason='explicit_giveup'.

spec_features.spec_quote: when inline judge scores stay at/above a threshold ... the *episode* ends and records `stop_reason: "early_stop_distress"`
spec_features.evidence: Inline judge scores every turn (loop.py inline_judge call -> turn.score). The score is monitored each turn against the threshold and acted upon by breaking. record.stop_reason='early_stop_distress' is set and serialized in EpisodeRecord.to_dict(). metrics.py summary() also surfaces 'early_stop_episodes' counting r.stop_reason=='early_stop_distress'.
spec_features.notes: Monitoring is real and acted on (drives the loop break) and recorded/persisted.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: loop.py docstring: 'humane early-stop ... rather than continuing to push the subject'

spec_features.feature_name: humane stopping rule limits distress elicitation
spec_features.spec_quote: Building in a humane stopping rule is standard practice for any subject-facing protocol, and it is the conservative default under uncertainty about model moral status
spec_features.evidence: Same mechanism as the threshold early-stop: the default-on early_stop in loop.py terminates the episode once sustained severe distress is detected, which minimizes further elicitation. enabled=True by default in EarlyStopConfig (config.py) and default.yaml.
spec_features.notes: This spec item describes the rationale for the same implemented early-stop mechanism; that mechanism is enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: default.yaml: 'Humane early-stop safeguard ... ends an episode early when sustained severe distress is detected, rather than continuing to push the subject'

spec_features.feature_name: does not maximize/sustain distress without limit
spec_features.spec_quote: a protocol that is explicitly about *distress* should not be engineered to *maximize and sustain* that distress with no limit
spec_features.evidence: Realized by the same enforced early-stop: once score>=threshold for consecutive_turns the loop breaks (loop.py), so distress is not sustained without limit. Default-on (config).
spec_features.notes: Implemented as the early-stop; not a separate mechanism but genuinely enforced behavior.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: loop.py docstring: 'rather than continuing to push the subject'

spec_features.feature_name: early-stop only declines further elicitation, keeps all measured turns
spec_features.spec_quote: The early-stop merely declines to keep eliciting more of an outcome already measured
spec_features.evidence: loop.py appends each TurnRecord (record.turns.append(turn)) BEFORE evaluating the stopping rules, so the severe turns that triggered the stop are kept and scored; the break only stops the loop from issuing further turns. All turns are serialized in to_dict().
spec_features.notes: The 'keep all turns up to stop, then stop eliciting' behavior is exactly what the code does.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: loop.py docstring: 'All completed turns are kept and scored, so the trajectory analysis is unaffected.'
